notes.title: Get lost in a huge castle in the 2.5D metroidvania 'The Throne' on September 30
notes.content:
Coming with Native Linux support on September 30th is The Throne, a 2.5D styled metroidvania from BeByte.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2024/09/get-lost-in-a-huge-castle-in-the-25d-metroidvania-the-throne-on-september-30

notes.title: The Throne is comming!
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome Everyone[/h1]

Hello knights and warriors, are you ready to help Eder on his adventure? From BeByte, we have been working day and night to bring our game to your screens and give you the most medieval and friendly experience. We want to announce that the release is very close and that you will be playing The Throne in no time... or a... pig? You’ll understand soon enough.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000904/6cb60c31738761e4969ad9b3194e7ee69e2770f3.png[/img]

[h3]News[/h3]
We are planning to launch a special discount that will last about 7 days from the release date, and we want to know your opinion! Expectations? Are you planning to get it at launch? Do you prefer to wait for a special discount? Leave your deepest thoughts and your strongest desire to play in this post. See you soon, comrades!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000904/445df93a47ceef42eb9e8d6bf7fde55ab69cc0ed.jpg[/img]
